faqStatic.question: How do I book a tour?
faqStatic.answer: Select a tour from the list, choose a date on the calendar, and fill in your details. Booking is instant — no account needed.

faqStatic.question: Can I cancel my booking?
faqStatic.answer: Yes. You can cancel using your booking reference and email address. Please cancel at least 24 hours before the tour.

faqStatic.question: What is included in the tour price?
faqStatic.answer: Every tour includes a guided walk, live Scoville tastings, and a small take-home gift from the farm. No hidden extras.

faqStatic.question: Are children allowed?
faqStatic.answer: Yes! Our tours are family-friendly and suitable for all ages. Please supervise young children during the tasting stations.

faqStatic.question: How spicy are the tastings?
faqStatic.answer: We offer a range of heat levels — from mild and sweet to very hot. Your guide will explain the Scoville scale and tailor tastings to your preference.

faqStatic.question: Is the farm accessible for people with disabilities?
faqStatic.answer: Most of the farm is accessible. Some field paths may have uneven ground. We recommend contacting us in advance so we can best accommodate you.

about.title:
More than a farm.
A story grown from the ground up.
about.subtitle: A living farm, a visitor destination, and a personal journey — all in one place. Come explore over 150 varieties of hot peppers and discover where passion meets the soil.
about.storyBody1: Life doesn't always follow the path we imagine. For the founder of Hadiners, a career in farming was never part of the plan — until everything changed.
about.storyBody2: After losing his beloved nephew Kfir in a car accident, the weight of grief pulled him away from the things he once loved. For a while, it felt like part of him had gone too. Then something unexpected happened.
about.storyBody3: He planted a pepper. And then another. And then a hundred more.
about.storyBody4: What started as quiet therapy slowly became a full-scale farm — and eventually, a place where other people could come to connect with nature, learn, and find a little joy among the plants.
about.storyBody5: Today, Hadiners is a thriving visitor attraction and a family business built by hand on love, loss, and an unstoppable passion for spice.
about.quote: "What started as a way to heal quietly became a place where others could feel at home too."
about.offersTitle: A full day of spicy discovery
about.offersSubtitle: Whether you're a seasoned chilli lover or curious for the first time, there's something here for you.

offers.title: 150+ Pepper Varieties
offers.text: Explore one of the largest collections of hot peppers in the region — from mild and fruity to scorching rare varieties sourced from every corner of the world.

offers.title: Guided Farm Tours
offers.text: Walk the growing tunnels with a knowledgeable guide. See the plants up close, learn how each variety is cultivated, and hear the story behind the farm.

offers.title: Handcrafted Products
offers.text: Our small-scale production facility turns fresh peppers into hot sauces, chutneys, and spice blends — all made on-site with care and quality.

offers.title: Tasting & Education
offers.text: Compare heat levels on the Scoville scale, taste fresh and processed peppers, and leave with real knowledge about origins, colours, and flavour profiles.

offers.title: Seeds & Seedlings
offers.text: Take a piece of the farm home. We offer a curated selection of seeds and young seedlings so you can start your own spicy growing journey.

offers.title: Family-Friendly Experience
offers.text: An inclusive, outdoor experience designed for all ages — couples, families, and curious solo visitors who want something different from a typical day out.
